name: La Trobe Student Union Placement Travel Support
summary: A $50 petrol or public transport voucher each semester for Bundoora students on a required placement.
key: One $50 voucher per semester, for petrol or public transport.
who: Enrolled at La Trobe's Melbourne Bundoora campus, on a placement your course requires.
Not on a placement that gets the Commonwealth Prac Payment (international students in those fields can still apply).
how: Complete the online form with your placement details. Processing can take up to 14 business days.
catches: Applications closed for Semester 2, 2026 and reopen next semester.
